title: Chat & Briefing
markdown:
**What it is:** The home surface where you talk to the Executive in plain language. It opens on a *briefing* — a quick read of what's happened across the company — and you drop into a chat whenever you want to ask or decide something.

**What it does:**

- Hold a natural conversation with the Executive, which quietly pulls in whichever specialists a question needs.
- Keep separate chat sessions with full history, so you can pick up where you left off.
- Attach files to a message — up to 5 per turn, 20 MB each (images, PDF, Word, text, Markdown, CSV) — for the Executive to read alongside your knowledge base.
- Stop a reply while it is still coming — whatever has been written is kept and marked *Stopped by you*, so you can redirect without waiting the answer out. (Escape works too.)
- Toggle **Committee** on a question that matters: a slower pass where reviewers challenge the draft answer before you see it.
- Continue any briefing item straight into a chat thread, with the context already filled in.
- Open **Agent activity** in the top bar to watch what's happening behind a reply — which specialists were consulted and which tools ran.

**How to use:**

1. Click **New chat** in the sidebar. (Click **Briefing** any time to get back to the briefing.)
2. Type your question and press **Enter** to send — **Shift + Enter** starts a new line. When the box is empty, a greyed-out suggested follow-up may appear; press **Tab** or **→** to use it.
3. To include a file, click the paperclip next to the message box and pick up to 5 files. (Drag-and-drop isn't supported in chat.) Attachments are read for that conversation only — to make a document permanently available, upload it to the Knowledge Base.
4. For a decision that matters, click the **Committee** pill next to Send *before* sending. It applies to that one message; you'll see *Drafting → Committee review → Revising* while it works.
5. Changed your mind mid-answer? Click the stop button (it replaces Send while a reply is streaming) or press **Esc**.
6. Rate a reply with 👍 / 👎, and find old conversations under **Recent** in the sidebar (it has a search box).

**Example prompts:**

- "Here's our Q3 board deck — what questions should I expect from the board?" *(with the PDF attached)*
- "Should we raise prices 10% for new customers? I want the finance and marketing view." *(with Committee on)*
- "What changed across the company this week that I should know about?"

*Tip: this is the front door — almost everything else in the app is something the Executive references or acts on from here.*
